snippet.title: Night Watch at Freddie's: The July 5th Archive - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Game Link: https://avocadodreams.itch.io/nwafjuly5th
---
"I found this game at a garage sale...

No, not really. I became friends with Bradley, one of Scot's kids, not too long ago. He was one of the prime beta-testers for the Night Watch at Freddie's series, so naturally I asked him if there was any early content he knew about for the games that he could share, mostly as a joke. Imagine my surprise when not only did he go straight to Scot and ask, but got permission to send over a fully intact prototype build of Night Watch at Freddie's 1!

According to Bradley, I've got the full go-ahead to release this to the public, as long as I let people know to support the official releases too! The prototype build is surprisingly stable, though if you want to play it yourself, chances are you'll get blindsided if you try to play this game like the 'real' Night Watch at Freddie's. You have been warned!"
https://www.scotproductions.net/
